items.title: 海外招聘市场回暖
items.source: BBC News · 风格仿写（原创）
items.intro: 跟面试相关的词汇密集，适合练话题联想。
sentences: Employers across Europe are stepping up recruitment of overseas engineers.
A recent survey suggests that a third of technology roles will be filled remotely this year.
Companies say the biggest shortage is in mid-level candidates with five to eight years of experience.
Recruiters warn that visa processing remains the most common bottleneck.
Candidates who can demonstrate strong spoken English continue to command a clear premium.
Analysts expect salaries for data roles to rise by around nine percent next year.
